harper: Customer reported unexpected route throttle caused by provisional cost spike during a streaming retry + model fallback. Filing here.
josh: sequence? sounds like the usual sampling/myriad-pricing mismatch.
harper: brief logs attached: client started on model=large (price=0.0008), reconnect triggered fallback to model=compact (price=0.00025). sampling captured tokens tagged with both prices; quota check used the earlier high-price samples -> throttle. ledger later reconciled at compact price.
min: paste logs please.
harper:```
[09:10:05.001] sample session=xyz model=redwood-large price=0.0008 tokens=90 cost=0.072
[09:10:05.210] network: reconnect
[09:10:05.310] router: fallback session=xyz -> redwood-compact price=0.00025
[09:10:05.315] sample session=xyz model=redwood-compact price=0.00025 tokens=12 cost=0.003
[09:10:05.410] quota check route=/beta provisional_cost=0.075 threshold=0.05 -> THROTTLE
[09:10:35.800] ledger commit session=xyz confirmed_cost=0.027 billed_model=redwood-compact
```
billing-bot: NOTE: final ledger cost lower than provisional sample.
josh: root cause: provisional aggregator sums samples across model tags and uses last-seen price for display but uses summed cost for quota checks without normalization. During mid-request model switches we can double-count high-price tokens.
min: mitigation options: 1) conservative quota calc during mixed model windows (use min observed price), 2) attach model_epoch to session and exclude pre-epoch samples from quota for short window, 3) cap per-session provisional impact on route quota.
harper: ops request prefers option 3 short-term (low-risk) + option 2 as long-term.
ops-bot: Created ticket ENG-3122 "Mid-request model switch provisional cost isolation" assigned @josh P1. BI-1022 "Runbook for provisional throttles" created for CS/OPS.
josh: plan: add model_epoch header from router, clear provisional buffer on epoch bump, TTL 6s before merging old epoch tokens. also implement per-session provisional cap = min(session_prov, 1.5 * route_threshold) as immediate hotfix and surface a banner in console when cap applied.
min: tests needed: streaming retry + fallback, sequence with toolcall truncation + reconnect, ensure no regressions in provisional smoothing.
harper: UI/ops ask: update console tooltip to explain provisional may include interim routing artifacts and show model_epoch used. CS wants a suggested customer message.
iris: I'll draft the tooltip + CS blurb, and add an alert that notifies ops when cap triggers.
josh: will open PR for cap change today and ENG-3122 design doc next week.
harper: thanks all, please tag me when PR is staged so I can demo to the customer. :thumbsup:
